sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae, pronotum, legs and abdomen paler; mandibles brown, yellow at the base. Head with a few erect hairs, 2 small setae on each side of the fontanelle; anterior margin of the pronotum with short hairs, posterior margin, sides and body with longer hairs; abdominal tergites densely covered with irregular hairs. Body length 3.08-3.6S mm. Head capsule pyriform, slightly longer than wide; head length (to mandible base) 1.03-1.08 mm, width 0.91-1.03 mm; rounded at the antennal sockets, then sharply narrowing anteriorly; posterior part rounded. Fontanelle distinct, tubular, opening nearly elliptical, situated at the base of the clypeus and bordered by a chitinous rim. Eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 smaller and narrower than segment 2, shorter than or nearly equal to segment 4; from segment 5 onwards pyriform and gradually enlarging. Postclypeus and anteclypeus short and narrow, trapezoidal. Labrum nearly triangular, longer than wide, 0.23 long and 0.17 mm wide; sides nearly parallel at the base, then converging towards the short, transparent apex, with 2 long setae near the apex. Mandibles not very long, 0.S7-0.63 mm long, sword-shaped, broad at the base, tapering towards the slightly incurved apex. Inner margin of the left mandible smooth on the distal half, with 4 (sometimes 5) obtuse teeth and a basal swelling on the proximal half. Inner margin of the right mandible smooth, with 3 obtuse teeth near the base. Postmentum short (median length 0.57-0.63 mm); widest at the anterior third (0.29-0.34 mm), converging from there to the anterior margin, then forming a broad waist at about the basal third (minimum or waist width 0.23-0.29 mm), and expanding again posteriorly into a weakly concave posterior margin. Pronotum flat, much wider than long (width 0.57-0.68 mm, length 0.37-0.40 mm); much narrower than the head; anterior margin convex with a deep median notch; posterior margin convex with a shallow median notch. Femora long; tibiae slender, tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Abdomen densely hairy; stylus 1-segmented, cerci 2-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellow; antennae, legs and pronotum paler; abdomen dirty white. Head densely hairy; abdominal tergites with dense, irregular hairs. Body length 2.74-2.91 mm. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (width 1.03 mm, length to mandible base 0.91 mm). Fontanelle, eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 12-15-segmented; segments 3 and 4 subequal, the shortest. Labrum wider than long (width 0.34 mm, length 0.29-0.34 mm); anterior part with a few hairs. Mandibles of the Coptotermes type. Pronotum much wider than long (width 0.51-0.57 mm, length 0.29 mm); anterior margin projecting forwards, with a deep, obtuse median notch; posterior margin convex, with a shallow median notch. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Distribution: Merembekenda, Sri Lanka, known only from the type locality; Great Nicobar Is., India. Alate unknown. Synonymy and misidentifications: Coptotermes exiguus Kemner (nomen nudum, 1930, Jepson et al.); Coptotermes exiguus Hagen / Eutermes exiguus Desneux (misidentification, 1953, Rattan Lal & Menon); Coptotermes ceylonicus Holmgren (in part, 1953, Roonwal & Pant, Merembekenda specimens only).

note: Rewritten from Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, The Fauna of India and the Adjacent Countries: Isoptera (Termites), Vol. I, pp. 442-445; the original records the alate (Imago) as Unknown. OCR misreadings are reproduced as printed, not conjecturally corrected: soldier body length "3.08-3.6S" (S probably 5), mandible length "0.S7-0.63" (S probably 5), postmentum passage "widest a : nterior one-third". The synonymy list is excerpted in the order of the original.
